task: Explain NEAR global contracts in 3 sentences.
deliverable: A global contract is code deployed to NEAR once and stored by its hash (or by an account id), so it is not copied into every account that uses it. Any account can then point at that code with a small UseGlobalContract action instead of paying storage for its own copy. Deploying it costs ten times the normal storage price per byte, which pays off once many accounts run the same code.

task: Give the formula for the lead's earned fee in Hire Tree and one example with numbers.
deliverable: earned = fee x paid / max(hired, floor), where floor is half the work budget. Example: fee 10 fUSD, work budget 90 so floor 45, the lead hired parts worth 60 and 30 of them passed: earned = 10 x 30 / 60 = 5 fUSD.
